label: FRITZ!Box 7590 VDSL2/ADSL2+ dual-band router
description: VDSL2 35b supervectoring (up to 300 Mbit/s) and ADSL2+ router with a 4x4 MU-MIMO dual-band access point (800 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz, 1733 Mbit/s on 5 GHz), one RJ-11 DSL port, four gigabit LAN ports and a separate gigabit WAN port for cable/fibre modems.
notes: AVM datasheet: 'All DSL lines with up to 300 Mbit/s', '4 x gigabit Ethernet', '1 x gigabit WAN', '4 x 4 Wireless AC + N with Multi-User MIMO', 1733 Mbit/s (5 GHz) + 800 Mbit/s (2.4 GHz). Corrects the older catalogue entry that pinned this 35b line to 100M: 35b is a 300M rung, and no DSL line here is gigabit.
